On July 28, AEI’s John Yoo and Adam J. White discussed Mr. Yoo’s new book, “Defender in Chief: Donald Trump’s Fight for Presidential Power” (All Point Books, 2020).
Despite what the president’s critics contend, Mr. Yoo argued that the Trump administration marks a return to the founding vision of the presidency as an office of “unity, vigor, and independence.” He noted that the Trump administration adheres to a traditional view of the Constitution, in which the president is independent of Congress and in charge of enforcing the laws. With this understanding of the presidency, Mr. Yoo sheds new light on the Trump administration’s constitutional controversies.
